response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with ~18 years of software development experience and genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators). However, this is a people-management role requiring at least 2 years of formal people management and 3 years of technical leadership, and the resume shows no evidence of managing engineers, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change. Mobile experience is limited to a stint on iOS/Apple TV apps nearly a decade ago, and there is no demonstrated experience with build systems or testing infrastructure at large-platform scale.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools background: open-source test runners (Trial), assertion libraries (Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD and DevOps setup, and recent AI/MCP tooling
Broad technical range (web, mobile, embedded, low-latency systems) exceeding the 8-year experience minimum
Evidence of mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, courses, and coding dojos
concerns: No formal people-management experience — no direct reports, 1:1s, or performance management shown, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated technical leadership at team/org level (roadmapping, org change, cross-team alignment) despite Staff-level titles
Mobile-platform experience is dated (2015–2016) and not at ecosystem/platform scale relevant to the role
